interface.signature: def getHappyString(n: int, k: int) -> str:

preconditions.description: The length of the happy string n must be between 1 and 10.
The position k must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The returned string must consist only of 'a', 'b', 'c' or be an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[i + 1] for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: Consecutive characters in the returned string must be different.
The length of the returned string must be equal to n or it must be an empty string.

postconditions.expression: sorted([''.join(p) for p in itertools.product('abc', repeat=n) if all(p[i] != p[i + 1] for i in range(len(p) - 1))])[k - 1] == return_value if k <= len([''.join(p) for p in itertools.product('abc', repeat=n) if all(p[i] != p[i + 1] for i in range(len(p) - 1))]) else return_value == ''
postconditions.description: The returned string must be the k-th lexicographical happy string of length n or an empty string if k is out of bounds.
